step.name: Side steps
step.cue: Step to your right and bring your other foot in. Then step left. Keep alternating.
step.detail: Step to your right and bring your other foot in. Then step left. Keep alternating.
step.shortCue: Step to your right and bring your other foot in. Then step left. Keep alternating.

weightshift.name: Weight shifts
weightshift.cue: Keep both feet on the floor. Shift your weight from one side to the other.
weightshift.detail: Keep both feet on the floor. Shift your weight from one side to the other.
weightshift.shortCue: Keep both feet on the floor. Shift your weight from one side to the other.

shoulders.name: Shoulder rolls
shoulders.cue: Let your arms hang by your sides. Slowly roll your shoulders back.
shoulders.detail: Let your arms hang by your sides. Slowly roll your shoulders back.
shoulders.shortCue: Let your arms hang by your sides. Slowly roll your shoulders back.

reach.name: Arm reaches
reach.cue: Reach your arms forward, then up as far as feels comfortable. Lower them and repeat.
reach.detail: Reach your arms forward, then up as far as feels comfortable. Lower them and repeat.
reach.shortCue: Reach your arms forward, then up as far as feels comfortable. Lower them and repeat.

squat.name: Squats
squat.cue: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart. Sit your hips back, bend your knees, then stand up.
squat.detail: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart. Sit your hips back, bend your knees, then stand up.
squat.shortCue: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart. Sit your hips back, bend your knees, then stand up.

shallow.name: Small squats
shallow.cue: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart. Bend your knees a little, then stand up.
shallow.detail: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart. Bend your knees a little, then stand up.
shallow.shortCue: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart. Bend your knees a little, then stand up.

wallpush.name: Wall push-ups
wallpush.cue: Face a wall, with your hands at chest height. Bend your elbows to move toward it, then press back.
wallpush.detail: Face a wall, with your hands at chest height. Bend your elbows to move toward it, then press back.
wallpush.shortCue: Face a wall, with your hands at chest height. Bend your elbows to move toward it, then press back.

wallclose.name: Easy wall push-ups
wallclose.cue: Stand close to a wall, hands at chest height. Bend your elbows a little, then press back.
wallclose.detail: Stand close to a wall, hands at chest height. Bend your elbows a little, then press back.
wallclose.shortCue: Stand close to a wall, hands at chest height. Bend your elbows a little, then press back.

hinge.name: Hip hinges
hinge.cue: Keep your knees slightly bent. Move your hips back while your chest tips forward, then stand up.
hinge.detail: Keep your knees slightly bent. Move your hips back while your chest tips forward, then stand up.
hinge.shortCue: Keep your knees slightly bent. Move your hips back while your chest tips forward, then stand up.

hingesmall.name: Small hip hinges
hingesmall.cue: Keep a slight bend in your knees. Move your hips back a little, then stand up.
hingesmall.detail: Keep a slight bend in your knees. Move your hips back a little, then stand up.
hingesmall.shortCue: Keep a slight bend in your knees. Move your hips back a little, then stand up.

march.name: Standing marches
march.cue: Lift one knee, lower your foot, then switch sides. Keep your pace comfortable.
march.detail: Lift one knee, lower your foot, then switch sides. Keep your pace comfortable.
march.shortCue: Lift one knee, lower your foot, then switch sides. Keep your pace comfortable.

toetap.name: Alternating toe taps
toetap.cue: Tap one foot a little forward, return it, then switch. Move gently.
toetap.detail: Tap one foot a little forward, return it, then switch. Move gently.
toetap.shortCue: Tap one foot a little forward, return it, then switch. Move gently.

sideleg.name: Side leg raises
sideleg.cue: Touch a wall for balance. Lift one leg to the side, lower it, and switch sides.
sideleg.detail: Touch a wall for balance. Lift one leg to the side, lower it, and switch sides.
sideleg.shortCue: Touch a wall for balance. Lift one leg to the side, lower it, and switch sides.

sidetap.name: Side toe taps
sidetap.cue: Tap one foot out to the side, bring it back, then switch sides.
sidetap.detail: Tap one foot out to the side, bring it back, then switch sides.
sidetap.shortCue: Tap one foot out to the side, bring it back, then switch sides.

squeeze.name: Shoulder-blade squeezes
squeeze.cue: With your arms by your sides, draw your shoulder blades together. Release and repeat.
squeeze.detail: With your arms by your sides, draw your shoulder blades together. Release and repeat.
squeeze.shortCue: With your arms by your sides, draw your shoulder blades together. Release and repeat.

calf.name: Calf raises
calf.cue: Use a wall for balance. Lift your heels, then lower them slowly.
calf.detail: Use a wall for balance. Lift your heels, then lower them slowly.
calf.shortCue: Use a wall for balance. Lift your heels, then lower them slowly.

calfsmall.name: Small calf raises
calfsmall.cue: Touch a wall for balance. Lift your heels a little, then lower them.
calfsmall.detail: Touch a wall for balance. Lift your heels a little, then lower them.
calfsmall.shortCue: Touch a wall for balance. Lift your heels a little, then lower them.

breathe.name: Rest
breathe.cue: Take a break. Stand or sit comfortably.
breathe.detail: Take a break. Stand or sit comfortably.
breathe.shortCue: Take a break. Stand or sit comfortably.

coolstep.name: Easy steps
coolstep.cue: Slow your steps down. Let your arms relax.
coolstep.detail: Slow your steps down. Let your arms relax.
coolstep.shortCue: Slow your steps down. Let your arms relax.

tempo_squat.name: Slow-lowering squats
tempo_squat.cue: Lower over about three seconds, within a comfortable range. Pause briefly, then stand. Keep breathing.
tempo_squat.detail: Lower over about three seconds, within a comfortable range. Pause briefly, then stand. Keep breathing.
tempo_squat.shortCue: Lower over about three seconds, within a comfortable range. Pause briefly, then stand. Keep breathing.

wall_slow.name: Slow wall push-ups
wall_slow.cue: Hands on the wall at chest height. Bend your elbows slowly, then press back. Stay in control.
wall_slow.detail: Hands on the wall at chest height. Bend your elbows slowly, then press back. Stay in control.
wall_slow.shortCue: Hands on the wall at chest height. Bend your elbows slowly, then press back. Stay in control.

split_left.name: Left-foot-forward split squats
split_left.cue: Left foot forward, right foot back. Hold a sturdy wall for balance if needed. Bend both knees a little, then rise. Feet stay planted.
split_left.detail: Left foot forward, right foot back. Hold a sturdy wall for balance if needed. Bend both knees a little, then rise. Feet stay planted.
split_left.shortCue: Left foot forward, right foot back. Hold a sturdy wall for balance if needed. Bend both knees a little, then rise. Feet stay planted.

split_right.name: Right-foot-forward split squats
split_right.cue: Right foot forward, left foot back. Hold a sturdy wall for balance if needed. Bend both knees a little, then rise. Feet stay planted.
split_right.detail: Right foot forward, left foot back. Hold a sturdy wall for balance if needed. Bend both knees a little, then rise. Feet stay planted.
split_right.shortCue: Right foot forward, left foot back. Hold a sturdy wall for balance if needed. Bend both knees a little, then rise. Feet stay planted.

palms.name: Palm presses
palms.cue: Press your palms together at chest height. Hold briefly while breathing, then release.
palms.detail: Press your palms together at chest height. Hold briefly while breathing, then release.
palms.shortCue: Press your palms together at chest height. Hold briefly while breathing, then release.

calf_pause.name: Calf raises with a hold
calf_pause.cue: Touch a wall for balance. Lift your heels, hold briefly, then lower them slowly.
calf_pause.detail: Touch a wall for balance. Lift your heels, hold briefly, then lower them slowly.
calf_pause.shortCue: Touch a wall for balance. Lift your heels, hold briefly, then lower them slowly.

knee_pushup.name: Knee push-ups
knee_pushup.cue: Start on your hands and knees. Move your hands forward, keep a straight line from knees to shoulders, and bend then straighten your elbows.
knee_pushup.detail: Use a comfortable range. Stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt.
knee_pushup.shortCue: From a knee-supported push-up position, bend your elbows, then press up.
